description: Implications chain: a token emitted with A takes b, and then c and d from b's implication. An implication whose left side the token does not meet adds nothing (engine §11).
grammar:
%implies B ⟹ (C ∪ D)
%implies A ⟹ B
%implies Z ⟹ Y
%rule text [{word}]
%rule word $w:W :: ($w.tags ∪ A) %emits $
